verdict.rationale: Postmark documents creating, editing and listing templates via API, validating templates, and pushing templates between servers. It also offers template-based send endpoints (single and batch) that take TemplateAlias and TemplateModel variable payloads. Template versioning is not documented anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: documented template versioning/history, explicit send-by-numeric-TemplateId detail, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, version, and update email templates through the API and trigger sends by template id with variable payloads
